symbols.name_en: Position switch function; limit switch function
symbols.name_fr: Fonction contact de position
symbols.description: Position switch function. Limit switch function
notes: This qualifying symbol can be applied to simple contact symbols to indicate position or limit switches if there is no need to show the means of operating the contact. In complicated cases, where it is desirable to show the means of operating, symbols 02-13-16 to 02-13-19 should be used instead.
This symbol is placed on both sides of the contact symbol when the contact is mechanically operated in both directions.

symbols.name_fr: Fonction retour automatique
notes: This symbol may be used to indicate spring return function. When this convention is used, its use should be appropriately referenced.
This symbol should be used together with qualifying symbols 07-01-01, 07-01-02, 07-01-03 and 07-01-04. In many cases, symbol 02-12-07 may be used.

symbols.name_fr: Fonction position maintenue
notes: This symbol may be used to indicate non-spring return function. When this convention is invoked, its use should be appropriately referenced.
This symbol should not be used together with qualifying symbols 07-01-01..04. In many cases, symbol 02-12-08 may be used.
